entities.summary: Colette Capdevielle is a French Socialist politician who has represented Pyrénées-Atlantiques's 5th constituency in the National Assembly of France since the 2024 French legislative election. She represented the same seat in the 14th legislature of the French Fifth Republic, between 2012 and 2017.
